verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly ships an llms.txt index (confirmed live via probe returning HTTP 200 with markdown page index) and documents that any doc page can be appended with .md for agent-friendly markdown, directly matching the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. This is independently corroborated by a hands-on probe rather than just vendor claims. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths, so the machine-readable API schema companion to llms.txt is incomplete.
